artifacts.notes: Extent as the retrieving lane measured it: Complete page master image, Semi-weekly interior journal 1895-11-19 ed-1 page 2, 5204x7461 px 8-bit greyscale; the highest resolution the Library of Congress publishes for this page. Whole page, not a crop. The retrieving lane records this item as VERIFIED BY COLLATION AGAINST THE PAGE IMAGE for the quoted sentences at the named crop region, and for no further.
artifacts.rights_basis: The issue was published in the United States before 1929 and is in the public domain there; the retrieving research lane of run efff3a6f73c1f451 recorded the same finding, in the form 'nineteenth-century American newspaper digitised by the Library of Congress; public domain'. The Library of Congress's mechanical digitisation and optical recognition of a public-domain page add no original authorship of their own. The bytes are retained at 4.85 MB because they are the evidence itself: the retrieving lane collated its quotations against this page image and not against the optical text, and a reader with no network needs the image to repeat that collation. guidance/sources.md makes retention the default and names size as the only other exemption; this file is below the 5.88 MB that is the largest payload this library retains.
